entries.title: Psalms 124:2
segments: When men rose up against us; the men here spoken of are the enemies of Israel, the true visible church of God; the men who sought to destroy the nation, and with it the institutions of religion.

entries.title: Psalms 124:3
segments: Quick; alive, as men are devoured by wild beasts, or swallowed up by earthquakes.

entries.title: Psalms 124:5
segments:
Proud waters; swelling waters, but with an allusion to the pride of Israel's enemies. 
 
God's church hath no power of her own to withstand the assaults of Satan and wicked men.  Were it not for his continual presence and protection, these would soon utterly destroy her.

entries.title: Psalms 124:7
segments:
Our soul; our life; that is, we have escaped alive. 
 
God can easily break all the snares which wicked men spread for the feet of his people; and he will do so, for the sake of his own glory and their good.

entries.title: Psalms 124:8
segments: Since God who made heaven and earth is the Helper of his people, their cause must prosper, until the whole world shall be brought to the knowledge and obedience of the gospel.
